predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: the eleven states: 'nine Malay states and two of the Straits Settlements, Penang and Malacca'

successors.name: Malaysia
successors.text: Peninsular Malaysia: 'In 1963, the Federation was reconstituted as Malaysia'

ledger.x: 1957: the Federation of Malaya becomes independent (31 August) under Tunku Abdul Rahman.
1957: the protected state of 1948-1957 becomes sovereign (31 August); Singapore, Sarawak and North Borneo stay British.
1963: the Federation is reconstituted as Malaysia (16 September).

wars.name: Malayan Emergency
wars.outcome: 'Commonwealth victory'; 'On 31 July 1960 the Malayan government declared the state of emergency to be over'; the remaining MNLA 'fled to the Thai border'.

certainty.note: The frontier is the Peninsula's coasts, the Johor Strait and the Thai boundary; no page opened gives a border dispute.
